claim: vitest >=5.0.0 changed the default of `clearMocks`. clearMocks default is true: Vitest automatically calls vi.clearAllMocks before each test. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: vitest >=5.0.0 changed what `vi.fn` does. Instances of a class passed to vi.fn keep the prototype chain of the class, so prototype methods stay available and instanceof checks against the class pass. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: vitest >=5.0.0 changed what `Duration` does. The Duration line of the summary breaks the run down into phases as percentages of tracked time. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: vitest >=5.0.0 renamed `experimental_parseSpecifications` to `parseSpecifications`. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: vitest >=5.0.0 changed what `attachmentsDir` does. attachmentsDir is resolved relative to the root Vitest config; it cannot be configured per project. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: vitest >=5.0.0 changed what `projects` does. Inline projects that don't modify the Vite config reuse the Vite server of the config that declares them. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: vitest >=5.0.0 changed the default of `browser.locators.exact`. Locators match text exactly by default, requiring a full, case-sensitive match; individual locator calls can override this default via their own exact option.
label: differential

claim: vitest >=5.0.0 changed the default of `HTML reporter`. HTML reporter outputDir option default value is .vitest; the report entry is written to .vitest/index.html. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: test
